settings.tab_content: Equipped with a proprietary dual-core high-performance 24-bit DSP processing chip operating at 192kHz sample rates. Ensures phase alignment and zero clock jitter.
Direct low-latency ASIO drivers enable real-time sub-1.2ms round-trip audio path latency, making this suitable for live performance mapping.
Machined from a solid block of aircraft-grade anodized aluminum, offering structural EMI/RFI shielding and excellent heat dissipation.
Includes open-source control API access, fully MIDI-mappable configurations, and plug-and-play compatibility across all major digital audio workstations.
